pages.text: Gatehouses are ruined walled entrances and sections of fortification. Search around the opening and walls as you pass through. A gatehouse can stand alone, so follow visible landmarks to find a settlement.

Generic villages form around town centers and stretch into houses and paths. They contain Atum villagers, job blocks, and sometimes crates. Villages are a place to trade and resupply. See $(l:atum:people/villagers)Villager Trades$(/l).
